title: Unit multiplication preserves divisibility of representatives
statement: Let M,d be natural numbers with M > 0 and d ∣ M. For any x,u ∈ ZMod M with u a unit, d divides the canonical representative of xu if and only if d divides the canonical representative of x.
lean_statement: ∀ (M d : ℕ), 0 < M → d ∣ M → ∀ (x u : ZMod M), IsUnit u → (d ∣ (x * u).val ↔ d ∣ x.val)
